summary: Route scout and delivery workbook for VD-96-072 (Elvarmere Biosciences AB, EB05 pyrrolopyridine series). It records the bromination step that gave two ring-position regioisomers, their separation by preparative HPLC and assignment by 2D NMR, and the 24 analogues delivered for the first potency screen, with isolated yields and delivery-lot purity.

properties.title: VD-96-072 route scout and delivery workbook

sheets.name: Summary
rows: Route A taken forward. The separated regioisomer goes into the analogue set; the mixture does not.

Accepted ring-position assignment: VD-96-072 compound cards and their HMBC/NOESY spectrum records under VA19960654; read with EB05_RteA_13Feb97.ppt. A is a separation label, not a ring-position designation.

sheets.name: Route scout

rows.v: Route scout: pyrrolopyridine core and side-chain steps

rows: Core bromination, NBS in DMF, room temperature
Two regioisomers in the crude. Ratio read from the HPLC trace, not yet a yield.
Preparative HPLC separation of the regioisomers
Regioisomer A isolated. Regioisomer B kept as the reference for the ring-position question.

Desired separated regioisomer taken forward. Accepted ring-position structure is on the VD-96-072 compound card; consult linked HMBC/NOESY spectrum record under VA19960654 rather than treating fraction label A as the assignment.
Suzuki coupling, aryl boronic acid, Pd(PPh3)4, K2CO3
Route gate passed: coupling clean on the model aryl, so the set can go ahead.
Amide formation, EDC/HOBt, amine in excess
Route risk. The piperazine-bearing members need the excess amine and a longer work-up.
Swap the aryl boronic acid at step 4 and keep steps 1 to 3 fixed. No further bromination work is planned for this series.
